text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: You look kind of sleepy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"A little. I was up late listening to a 
friend's troubles."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Call out to everyone in the Ritto Dorm.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"After asking one person, I figured there 
might be others. Everyone really is 
carrying their own burdens, huh."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia did her utmost to help solve 
her friend's worries, but she didn't seem 
to get much rest as a result...
